adjudication.method: AI-assisted evidence adjudication of two independent human rankings
adjudication.basis: Compare both human orders with blinded action evidence. Prioritize explicit actions over passive review; among explicit actions prioritize earlier action deadlines. Use premium and product fit only when action and timing are comparable. Preserve original human rankings.
adjudication.limitation: Disagreements were resolved by an AI assistant at the user request, not by a third human or a joint agreement of the two annotators. The consensus_relevance field holds adjudicated labels; report this provenance when evaluating.
adjudication.independence: No M4 scores, derived scoring features, baseline rankings or evaluation metrics were used to select the final order.
